name: Calendar (Patched)
description: Built-in calendar widget with minimum and maximum width exposed as package settings.
author: evan

lookahead.title: Look ahead (hours)
lookahead.description: Hours ahead to look for the next meeting. 1 to 168.

soon.title: Upcoming warning (minutes)
soon.description: Minutes before the start when the upcoming warning begins. 1 to 120.

now.title: Starting warning (minutes)
now.description: Minutes before the start when the starting warning begins. 0 to 60.

minWidth.title: Minimum width
minWidth.description: Points. 0 lets the widget shrink to its content.

maxWidth.title: Maximum width
maxWidth.description: Points. Must not be smaller than the minimum width.

calendar1.title: Calendar 1
calendar1.description: Calendar name to include, as shown in Calendar.

calendar2.title: Calendar 2
calendar2.description: Calendar name to include, as shown in Calendar.

calendar3.title: Calendar 3
calendar3.description: Calendar name to include, as shown in Calendar.

calendar4.title: Calendar 4
calendar4.description: Calendar name to include, as shown in Calendar.
